summary.bn: বেশি ভোল্টেজকে কম, স্থির ভোল্টেজে নামায় (যেমন ৯ V থেকে ৫ V), ৩ A পর্যন্ত। ট্রিমার ঘুরিয়ে আউটপুট ঠিক করা হয়।
summary.en: Turns a higher voltage into a lower, steady one (such as 9 V into 5 V), up to 3 A. Its trimmer sets the output.

simplified: Its output holds the voltage set on its trimmer while the input is at least about 1.2 V higher (the switch's own drop, from TI's datasheet); below that the output follows the input, 1.2 V lower. It works from 4.5 V in.
It draws from its input the power it gives, divided by an efficiency of 80 % (an estimate: TI gives 73 % at 12 V in, 3 V out and 3 A, and more at lighter loads), plus about 5 mA of its own.
It switches at 150 kHz on the real board; the lab shows the averaged result, with no ripple.
The lab warns above 40 V in or 3 A out. Its heat is not modelled.
